messages:
anika: heads-up 9 docs linkcheck failing on a cluster of anchor mismatches after yesterday's copy edits. CI shows 7 hits in /reference and /guides where links include parentheses or emoji. example: /reference/clients#client(initialization) -> 404 since slugified id becomes 'client-initialization'.

jess: yup saw those. a few authors used inline anchors like [init](#client(initialization)) when file headings contain parentheses. remark-slug strips punctuation so the links don't match.

liam: quick fix plan: update explicit fragment links to slugified form. I'll run a targeted grep for '\(initialization\)' and similar patterns before doing replacements. avoid broad sed across the repo.

tariq: also add a unit step to docs CI that runs a small node script checking that every markdown fragment link maps to an anchor in the rendered HTML. short-circuit before the heavy linkcheck. I'll open INFRA-2350.

jess: one gotcha: some internal contribs still reference old anchors in external blog posts. we should add redirects.yaml entries for the most common ones (client(initialization) -> client-initialization) so external links don't 404.

anika: agree on redirects. for the PR: limiter scope to the 7 CI-flagged files + a follow-up to add redirects and the CI precheck. reviewer: @tariq. please include the grep commands and show the preview link.

docs-bot: preview deploy for branch 'jess/paren-anchor-fix' is ready 	 https://deploy-preview-421.docs.redwood-inference.com

liam: note: found a stray markdown link that used percent-encoding: '#client%28initialization%29' which also fails since docusaurus doesn't decode that back to the slug. normalized it in my working copy. add a tiny line in CONTRIBUTING.md about not percent-encoding fragment identifiers.

jess: will open PR in 15m with the fixes, the redirects proposal, and a short test script in scripts/validate-fragments.js. tagging INFRA-2350 and requesting @anika + @tariq review.

anika: thanks. please include a short changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md explaining the redirects so support knows to expect 1-2 legacy 404s to go to the new slugs.

jess: added changelog note and pushed the branch, PR incoming.
